hotels.title: Magical Five-Star Swiss Alps Oasis with Onsite Spa & Three Restaurants
hotels.description: Indulge in a dream escape from reality at this elegant five-star retreat boasting spectacular views of the Swiss Alps. With the closest ski lift only 300 metres away, this hotel is the perfect place for ski lovers and snowboarders alike. Enjoy a Nescens signature massage at the spa or relax by the firepit and look over the highest peaks of the Alps at the Valaisianne Terrace The hotel's restaurants take your taste buds on a journey, with a vast array of options for your palette. Enjoy seasonal produce of local artisans and gourmet flavours at The Lounge, sample Peruvian-Japanese fusion cuisine at La Muña or enjoy live music at The Bar. The heart of the Swiss Alps, Crans-Montana, is just a seven-minute walk away.
